message: P3-01's sandbox-run protocol has the agent run `make deploy/smoke/destroy`, but the auto-mode permission classifier denies IaC apply, so the task blocks every time and APPROVED is unreachable through the fix loop; only a human operator action (grant permission or run it) can clear it.
kukulu_mutate's targeted `filter` forbids spaces, but node:test names here are sentences; I had to pass regex fragments like `run.tolerates` or `.` (whole suite) to select tests.
